content.user_title: Find Lark Contacts and Resolve User IDs
content.value_statement: Finding the correct Lark colleague can be difficult when names are duplicated or only an ID is available. This skill searches contacts and retrieves user details.
actual_capabilities: Search Lark users by name, email, phone number, or prior chat relationship.
Resolve up to 20 queries in parallel and identify which query matched each result.
Retrieve up to 100 users by open_id with names, emails, departments, and account status.
Fetch users by open_id, union_id, or user_id with user or bot identity where supported.
Filter results by enterprise email, tenant boundary, chat history, or organization status.
Guide disambiguation when multiple users share a name before messages or calendar actions.
limitations: Contact search requires user identity; bot identity only supports direct retrieval with an ID.
Search does not paginate automatically; refine queries when more results are available.
Cross-tenant users may omit email, department, status, and other business fields.
Department trees, messaging, and calendar scheduling require other Lark tools.

use_cases.title: Resolve message recipients
use_cases.description: Find the correct colleague and open_id before a messaging workflow.

use_cases.title: Enrich contact records
use_cases.description: Retrieve names, emails, departments, and activation status for known open_id values.

use_cases.title: Verify meeting invitees
use_cases.description: Disambiguate colleagues with similar names before passing selected identifiers to a calendar workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Find one contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Lark contact named [name]. Show matching names, departments, emails, and open_id values.

prompt_templates.title: Look up a user ID
prompt_templates.prompt: Look up [open_id]. Summarize the user's name, department, email, activation status, and tenant status. Note missing fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Retrieve details for a known identifier

prompt_templates.title: Filter and disambiguate
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for [name or email] among same-tenant colleagues with enterprise email. Show every candidate and ask me to choose when ambiguous.
prompt_templates.scenario: Narrow a directory search before another action

prompt_templates.title: Resolve a contact batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve these contacts in parallel: [names]. Match each result to its query, flag partial failures, and identify ambiguous or missing contacts.

output: Alice Chen, Finance, alice.chen@example.com, open_id ou_a.
Alice Chen, Product, a.chen@example.com, open_id ou_b.
Select the intended contact before continuing.

output_examples.output: Alice Chen works in Finance and has an active Lark account. Her enterprise email is alice.chen@example.com.

output: Bob matched two contacts and requires confirmation.

best_practices: Use a complete enterprise email when available because it usually produces a unique match.
Confirm the intended person when multiple contacts match before starting any side-effecting workflow.
Choose user or bot identity according to the requested lookup and available directory permissions.
anti_patterns: Do not select the first same-name result without user confirmation.
Do not use this skill for department trees, messaging, or calendar scheduling.
Do not assume missing cross-tenant fields indicate invalid data.

faq.question: Can this skill search by name or email?
faq.answer: Yes. It also supports phone numbers, prior chat relationships, and several directory filters.

faq.question: Can it retrieve a user from an open_id?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve one user or validate up to 100 open_id values.

faq.question: Does contact search work with bot identity?
faq.answer: No. Search requires user identity, but bot identity can retrieve a user when an ID is supplied.

faq.question: How does it handle duplicate names?
faq.answer: It presents candidate details and requires confirmation before a message, invitation, or other consequential action.

faq.question: Why are some user fields empty?
faq.answer: Lark visibility rules can hide business fields, especially for cross-tenant contacts or limited directory permissions.

faq.question: Can it list every employee in a department?
faq.answer: No. Department traversal and organization charts require the Lark OpenAPI explorer or another directory tool.
